questionText: When does a country has a positive balance of trade?

options.text:
If the value of imports traded is more than the value of a country's
exports.
If the value of exports is more than the value of imports.
If the value of exports is equal to the value of imports.
If the country only imports goods.

solution.quick: A favourable or positive balance of trade occurs when the total value of exported goods exceeds the total value of imported goods.
